rows: All platforms – 7-day trend (primary) with the 3-day read as a guide · Nov 19–25 vs Nov 12–18 · 3d Nov 23–25

Meta (blue) · Google Ads (green) · ShareChat (orange). Spend: Meta from Meta; Google and ShareChat from their dashboards (Google split by day/ad group with Adjust cost, scaled to the dashboard). Installs, retention, purchases and video events: Adjust for every platform. Same thresholds everywhere: Ret Effective CPI target ₹21 (Adjust CPI ÷ retention index; D1 14% / D7 3% / D30 0.7%); judged only with ≥ ₹1,500 or 50 installs in 7 days. Retention = the latest matured cohorts (7d: D1 of installs 1–7 days old, D7 of 7–13, D30 of 30–36; 3d: the 3 most recent matured days). When a window has too few installs for the retention index, the Adjust CPI is used and marked "*".
